name: 8th Kup

practical.title: Walking stance: front kick / double punch

theory.question: What is 'Closed Ready Stance C' in Korean?
What is three-step sparring?
theory.answer: A beginner's exercise for learning basics such as distance, facing, forearm conditioning, blocks, stances, counter-attacks and timing.

sparring: Three-step sparring (Sambo Matsoki) numbers 1-4. Attack: three middle-section front punches in walking stance, starting right leg back in low block. All defences start from parallel ready stance.
1: Right-leg-back walking stance, inner middle forearm block three times. Counter: reverse punch.

2: Left-leg-back L-stance, outer middle forearm block three times. Counter: advance left leg 45 degrees, bring right leg behind the opponent's front leg into left L-stance, right knifehand strike to the neck.
3: Left-leg-back L-stance, inward outer forearm block three times. Counter: slide forward into left L-stance, right front backfist to the face.
4: Left-leg-back L-stance, inward forearm block to the outside three times. Counter: move into sitting stance, focus with left hand, then double punch.

otherSections.heading: Dan-Gun pattern (21 movements)
items: Named after the legendary founder of Korea, 2333 BC. Starts and ends in parallel ready stance.
1 Knifehand guarding block, L-stance toward B
2 High punch, walking stance toward B
3 Knifehand guarding block, L-stance toward A
4 High punch, walking stance toward A
5 Low block, walking stance toward D
6-8 High punches toward D (right, left, right)
9 Twin forearm block, L-stance toward E
10 High punch toward E
11 Twin forearm block, L-stance toward F
12 High punch toward F
13 Low block, walking stance toward C
14 Rising block (left), continuous with 13
15-17 Rising blocks toward C (right, left, right)
18 Middle outward knifehand strike, L-stance toward B
19 High punch toward B
20 Middle outward knifehand strike, L-stance toward A
21 High punch toward A
End: left foot back to ready posture.
